title: Holiday Park Campground
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: With so much to see and do in and around Holiday Park, we're sure you will enjoy your stay. Our sites can accommodate any type of RV (self-contained). We have over 200 acres, mostly wooded, along the picturesque headwaters of the Choptank River.
